title: Ask again, with better options: may a session that waits on a reply set one timed check-in?
why: Item 290, deferred. Owner 20:07 CST Nov 5: "are these really the two options i should consider?" Lane timer-rules-conflict.
note: Re-ask with new options once the session mailbox (#1371) lands, since replies may then wake a session without a timer. Home record: docs/decisions/session-messages.md. Fix: none — answered on main (lane session-messaging-plan, 11:40 CST Nov 8; read by triage 11:41 CST): rule outcomes-mechanize-rules in CLAUDE.md says a one-time check-in set to wait for one named outside event, such as a reply, is not tracking, and the next waits for a new named event; docs/decisions/ci-wait-reads-run-status.md ties it to the owner's item 290 note ("shouldnt the rules first not conflict?"). The lane writes it into decision session-messages as Q4 after #1371 merges. No page item. Answered: owner in chat to the session-messaging topic session, 09:39 CST Nov 10: "ok one check in is allowed, i just don't think it'll be hollistic enough, but it's allowed that is enough". A session that waits on a reply may set one timed check-in for it; his concern that one check-in will not cover everything is kept as his note. Recorded in decision session-messages through #2544. Page item 484 closed.
